$sources: The species: Tulipa saxatilis Sieber ex Spreng., a stoloniferous tulip of Crete: leaves 2-4, lanceolate, shining, 15-25 cm by 1.5-2.5 cm; flowers 1-3, lilac-pink with a yellow base, the tepals 4-5.5 cm, cupped; flowering April (W. Blunt and C. Grey-Wilson, Flora of Crete, and the RHS Plant Finder).
The bulbs at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built orchard, HallOfLightPlanting.swift), heights 0.20-0.35.
name: Tulipa saxatilis
note: Out of flower in June, its leaves yellowing as they die back after flowering. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
